title: Code and figures for "Well-posedness, Stability, and Bifurcation in an Acid-Mediated Tumour Invasion Model with Interspecific Competition"
description:
Solver, symbolic verifications and figure generators for a three-component reaction–diffusion model of acid-mediated tumour invasion with interspecific competition. Includes the IMEX solver with a ghost-node Neumann Laplacian, the bifurcation and stability analysis, the bisection campaign for the critical seed radius with its cached results, the Fisher–KPP front-speed measurement, the nine figures of the manuscript as submitted, and the Supplementary Material of the manuscript, which states the analytical results the scripts verify.

Accompanies manuscript BMAB-D-26-00386, submitted to Bulletin of Mathematical Biology.
